The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] '''Model 57''' was a weapon similar in appearance to the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWI63">{{InsiderCite|63|Set Piece|Set Piece: Dagobah}}</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] purchased a number of these weapons from an arms dealer on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. One of them came into the ownership of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who used it alongside [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]].<ref name="Cloud City Limited" /> He started carrying the pistol a short time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="DSP">{{Kids1997Cite|issue1=16|issue2=20|story=Death Star Pirates}}</ref><ref name="SWI63" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The pistol was first seen being carried by Luke in {{Film|V}} and promotional images for the film. ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' misidentified Luke's Model 57 blaster in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as a [[Power 5 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

The film prop was a German [[Wikipedia:Mauser C96|Mauser C96]] semi-automatic pistol detailed with the plastic model kit parts of a V8 engine and a 1942 military sighting telescope.<ref name="SWI63" /> The same model of pistol was also the basis of the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] and [[Power 5 heavy blaster pistol]] props from the [[Original trilogy|original film trilogy]].
